name: ANSI/IEEE Solar generating station form
aliases: IEEE Solar Generating Station, In Service Or Unspecified
summary: IEEE-library form of solar generating station: a solar generating station is a system-level representation of a documented solar-generation facility.
description: This reference locates solar generating station in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented power stations family. A solar generating station is a system-level representation of a documented solar-generation facility. It identifies the facility type on a system diagram rather than replacing its internal electrical design. The public library uses HDV1_S00400 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Use linked SLDs to identify the array, inverter and connection equipment within the station. A station-type marker is a site-level concept, not a single PV module symbol. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
